places.quote: If he takes me by the hand and leads me through Westminster Hall in an airy procession after fortune, I must go.
places.note: Figurative reference to the law courts; the characters are not there.

places.quote: Richard, with an exclamation of surprise, hurried away
places.note: Passage says 'run down to the Dedlock' and 'the Dedlock Arms'; the inn is in the fictional village.

places.quote: I have the privilege of supporting an aged father in the Vale of Taunton—his native place—and I admire that country very much.
